sentence_stem: There was not much milk in the fridge, so
correct_completion: I bought some more at the shop.
full_sentence: There was not much milk in the fridge, so I bought some more at the shop.
acceptable_variants: I went to the shop to buy some.
I walked to the store and got a new carton.

options.text: I drank all of the water.
options.why_wrong: The stem is about milk, not water. The option does not connect to the shortage of milk in the fridge.

options.text: I was very happy about the milk.
options.why_wrong: This describes a feeling, not an action that results from having little milk.

options.text: I bought some more at the shop.
There were many eggs in the fridge.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the idea of a shortage and does not show a result of 'not much milk'.

grammar_focus: Quantifier 'not much' with a cause-and-effect connector 'so'
explanation: The word 'so' introduces a result. After 'not much', the clause should describe what the speaker did because of the shortage.
translation: Buzdolabında çok az süt vardı, bu yüzden dükkândan biraz daha aldım.
